tasks.test: deno task test:rust && deno task test:fixtures && deno task test:fixtures:profile-lock && deno task test:keywords && deno task test:concurrent && deno task test:copy && deno task test:pg-dump && deno task test:dump && deno task test:crash && deno task test:web && deno task test:wasm && deno task test:browser
tasks.test:web: deno task test:spy && deno task test:integration && deno task test:drizzle && deno task test:kysely && deno task test:postgres && deno task test:pg && deno task test:npm
tasks.fuzz: deno task fuzz:seed && cargo +nightly fuzz run double_meta_reopen -- -max_total_time=60 -rss_limit_mb=4096
tasks.test:wasm: deno task wasm:build && deno test -A tests-web/integration/pglet_wasm_test.ts
tasks.check: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && deno task check:stripped && deno task check:wasm-features && cargo fmt --check && deno task check:docs && deno task check:release
tasks.check:wasm-features: cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features pglet_wasm/default -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet -p pglet_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features pglet_wasm/default,pglet_wasm/opfs -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p pglet_wasm --all-targets --features opfs -- -D warnings
tasks.check:docs: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::invalid_html_tags' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --features pglet_wasm/opfs
tasks.size:gzip: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && gzip -c target/release/pglet_server | wc -c
tasks.size:check: deno task wasm:build && deno run --allow-read --allow-env --allow-run=gzip,git benches/size.ts --check
tasks.size:update: deno task wasm:build && cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-run=gzip,git benches/size.ts --update
tasks.bench:startup: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno run -A benches/startup.ts
tasks.bench:startup:update: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno run -A benches/startup.ts --update
tasks.bench:wasm-init: deno task wasm:build && deno run -A benches/wasm_init.ts
tasks.bench:wasm-init:update: deno task wasm:build && deno run -A benches/wasm_init.ts --update
tasks.bench:wasm-compare: deno task build:npm && deno run -A benches/wasm_compare.ts && node benches/wasm_compare.ts && bun benches/wasm_compare.ts
tasks.bench:wasm-compare:deno: deno task build:npm && deno run -A benches/wasm_compare.ts
tasks.bench:wasm-compare:update: deno task build:npm && deno run -A benches/wasm_compare.ts --update && node benches/wasm_compare.ts --update && bun benches/wasm_compare.ts --update
tasks.bench:exit-proof: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno task build:npm && deno run -A benches/exit_proof.ts
tasks.bench:exit-proof:update: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno task build:npm && deno run -A benches/exit_proof.ts --update
tasks.bench:memory: cargo build --release -p pglet_bench && deno task wasm:build && deno run -A benches/memory.ts
tasks.bench:memory:update: cargo build --release -p pglet_bench && deno task wasm:build && deno run -A benches/memory.ts --update
tasks.matrix:artifacts: cargo build --release -p pglet_server && deno task build:npm && deno run --allow-read tools/matrix_env.ts
tasks.wasm:build:opfs: wasm-pack build crates/pglet_wasm --target web --out-dir pkg-opfs --features opfs
tasks.build:npm: rm -rf crates/pglet_wasm/pkg-npm && wasm-pack build crates/pglet_wasm --target web --scope fuzdev --out-dir pkg-npm && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/patch_npm_package.ts crates/pglet_wasm/pkg-npm
tasks.test:npm: deno task build:npm && deno test -A tests-web/npm/ && node --test scripts/test_npm_node.mjs scripts/test_npm_pack.mjs
tasks.test:npm:node: deno task build:npm && node --test scripts/test_npm_node.mjs scripts/test_npm_pack.mjs
